reason: The geometry is measured correctly and everything else about the finding is wrong. (1) The premise is false. The plate is NOT the only ink that crosses the right margin. .b-behindSummary carries `padding: var(--gap-tight); margin: 0 calc(-1 * var(--gap-tight))` and `:hover { background: var(--fore-06) }`, so on hover it paints the identical 6% tint from 8px LEFT to 8px RIGHT of the content column at every width: measured 12->378 against a 20->370 column at 390, 88->680 against 96->672 at 768, 578->1262 against 586->1254 at 1440. Its own comment says why: 'the negative margin lets the pressable band run the full width of the measure without moving the text.' The page has a declared idiom -- a pressable band's plate bleeds symmetrically outward past the text box -- and the row plate is that idiom at 12px instead of 8px. The finding grades one instance of a system as a broken edge. (2) It is already the fix it asks for. `box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px` with spread only, no blur and no offset, on a box with `border-radius: 4px`, paints exactly a 12px-padded plate with a 16px outer radius -- pixel-for-pixel the `padding: 12px; border-radius: 16px` the fix proposes. The crop at 1440 shows a 16px-radius plate; the crop at 390 shows the words with 12px of air on the right and a rounded corner 8px off the screen. It is written as a shadow precisely BECAUSE .b-copy cannot take padding or margin (see 3 and 4). The finding concedes the left 12px 'reads as intended'; the same reasoning is what makes a plate a plate rather than a box clipped to the last glyph, and it applies on the right for the same reason. (3) The fix breaks a gate. `.b-item .b-copy { margin: -12px 0 -12px -12px }` is specificity 0-0-2-0 and outranks `.b-copy { margin-top: var(--push, 0px) }` at 0-0-1-0, so --push dies -- round 7's collision-avoidance answer, the one where the count travels with the words it names. Applied live at 1440/owner-editing, count-vs-copy drift goes from 2px on every row to 14px on every row, at rest AND after each of 20 stepper presses, against interaction-check.mjs's 4px threshold in 'no count is ever left beside another moment's words'. That gate exists because this exact defect was paid for once already. (4) The fix does not reach its own stated geometry. .b-copy is capped at `max-width: 544px` under `box-sizing: border-box`, so shifting the box 12px left leaves its right edge at 1242, not the 1254 the finding promises -- a NEW 12px shortfall against the footer and the rules, in the opposite direction -- and the row's measure shrinks from 544 to 520, rewrapping every title against render-core.js's word-safe trim and the 2-line clamp. So: the premise is factually wrong, the proposed rendering is what already ships, and the proposed mechanism regresses a gated behaviour while introducing the misalignment it claims to remove.
